text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Six killed as pro-Israeli SLA artillery targets Sidon city centre.
- Christian parties snubbed by Lebanon political conference.
- Amnesty condemns Israel's treatment of Lebanese prisoners.
- Parliament speaker said one of the aims of the shelling attack on Sidon was to undermine the five-nation group monitoring a ceasefire agreement in Lebanon.
- Sidon city goes on one-day strike to mourn the victims of Monday's shelling.
